title: Senator Rosilicie Ochoa Bogh addresses city priorities and legislative concerns in recent posts - East SBV Times
text:
Senator Rosilicie Ochoa Bogh has recently shared several updates on her official X account, addressing city priorities, legislative actions, and religious observances.
On September 29, 2025, Senator Ochoa Bogh expressed appreciation for a local official, stating: “Thank you, City manager Jennifer Crawford, for taking the time to meet and walk through the city’s priorities. I look forward to continuing that collaboration and building on the areas where our visions align for the good of the community.”
The following day, she addressed concerns regarding state legislation. On September 30, 2025, she posted: “I sent a letter to the Governor asking him to veto Assembly Bill 495. This bill expands current Education Code that is concerning for children. See my letter here “ Assembly Bill 495 has drawn attention due to its proposed changes to California’s Education Code.
On October 1, 2025, Senator Ochoa Bogh marked a significant religious occasion with her constituents by writing: “Wishing our Jewish neighbors a meaningful Yom Kippur filled with reflection and renewal. #YomKippur”
Senator Rosilicie Ochoa Bogh represents California’s Inland Empire region in the State Senate. Her recent communications reflect ongoing engagement with both local governance and statewide policy issues.
